seasonalTasks.title: Renovate matted rows post-harvest
seasonalTasks.body: Mow tops, narrow rows to 12 in, fertilize, irrigate. Within 1 wk of last harvest.

seasonalTasks.title: Apply straw winter mulch
seasonalTasks.body: 3 in straw after 2–3 hard frosts but before sustained cold.

seasonalTasks.title: Pull mulch off rows for spring growth
seasonalTasks.body: Mulch goes between rows for weed suppression + frost-cloth base.

seasonalTasks.title: Bloom frost watch
seasonalTasks.body: Open blossoms freeze at 30 °F; row cover + irrigation can save a crop.

notes: Standard June-bearing matted-row variety. 3-yr productive life; renovate annually. Native species-level tolerance to clopyralid (Stinger) is declared as a trait so the kernel's family-kill rule (synthetic-auxin → small-fruit) is overridden when stinger is the spray product.
